pitch2.headline: The creator's real problem isn't inspiration — it's capacity
pitch2.body:
73% of creators report burnout. The bottleneck isn't ideas — it's the production work around every piece of content.

**AI removes the friction that eats creative time:** research synthesis, format repurposing, caption variants, scheduling copy, thumbnail concepts.

Creators who trained deliberately reclaim that time. Those who experiment randomly add a new tool to their pile of half-used apps.

testimonial.quote: 76% of creators say AI accelerated their business or follower growth.
testimonial.author: Adobe Creators' Toolkit Report 2025 · 16,000 creators across 8 countries

pitch.headline: Why most creators get generic results from AI
pitch.body:
Generic prompting produces generic output. Every creator using the same "write me a caption" prompt gets the same caption.

**Voice preservation is a trainable skill.** AITutoro teaches you to calibrate AI output to your specific style, audience, and format — through prompt engineering, not guesswork.

81% of creators say AI enables them to produce content types they couldn't before. That's not access — that's training.
